opening.argument: The presentation promotes an Ethereum flash-loan contract as a way to make money while giving viewers a step-by-step path to use it. It instructs them to connect MetaMask to the Ethereum mainnet, fund the deployed contract, and click “action” to execute arbitrage. The speaker then claims, “we gained a little bit less than four ethereum for just a tiny bit of gas” and invites viewers to try the method themselves. Although the description states that results may vary and are not guaranteed, that disclaimer does not overcome the promotional profit claim, the request to send ETH to a contract, or the absence of independent proof that the displayed activity produced the asserted return. The material therefore presents a high-risk contract-funding method as a route to substantial Ethereum gains, while its own evidence does not establish the claimed outcome.
